newsitem.title: USA: Genetics Institute wins license for BENEFIX.
newsitem.headline: Genetics Institute wins license for BENEFIX.

text.p: Genetics Institute Inc., a wholly owned subsidiary of American Home Products Corp, said Wednesday that the U.S. Food and Drug Administration has licensed BENEFIX, Coagulation Factor IX (Recombinant), a clotting factor used to treat hemophilia B.

Made through biotechnology, plasma-free, albumin-free BENEFIX is a breakthrough product, the company said. For the first time, patients will have access to a product that is inherently free from the risk of transmission of human blood borne pathogens such as HIV, hepatitis viruses and parvovirus. This has not been previously possible with products derived from human blood. BENEFIX is made and distributed by Genetics Institute in the United States and distributed by Baxter Healthcare Corp in Europe.
